# Horizon Veinminer provenance

This Android integration incorporates the native Rust Veinminer implementation
from the Horizon Veinminer project.

- Source: https://github.com/levzzz5154/horizon-veinminer
- Source version: 0.3.2
- License: MIT
- Copyright: 2026 Horizon Veinminer contributors
- Minecraft target: 26.3
- Horizon compatibility revision: d91cab68ded29bd2b004f7050c468fb98c41a00b
- Horizon Mixins revision: 4342a0bfbe71d4d14185528d64e496d6022f16a1

The Android integration adapts the native runtime to the Android client's
game, command and LAN action paths. It is an unofficial community integration.
The original license is preserved in this directory.
